posts: Spent the weekend dithering clouds for a new 32x32 sunset scene — eight shades of coral and I'm still not satisfied. Slow pixels are happy pixels. #pixelart #nearart
Mint prep: a tiny animated lantern sprite, 12 frames, every pixel placed by hand. Palette locked at 16 colors because constraints are the whole fun. Coming to NEAR soon. #nfts #pixelart

replies.text: GM! Coffee poured, grid open, lantern sprite waiting. The pixel-art corner of NEAR is awake too ✨
